digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs and output formatting
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently exit with empty stdout on success, making success and idempotent no-ops indistinguishable and forcing agents to run a follow-up 'rebar show' to verify writes

Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must print a one-line kubectl-style confirmation stating the mutation outcome (e.g. 'linked X -> Y (relation)' on write, 'no change: already linked X -> Y (relation)' on no-op) with exit 0 both ways

Global --quiet and --output flags must be extracted at the top-level router before verb dispatch to uniformly apply to all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with --quiet suppressing confirmation text only and --output json emitting a single structured mutation envelope

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract preserving all data in their original output, and reopen must gain a confirmation line

link's REDIRECT record (raw JSON) must remain byte-identical before and after the change on both write and no-op paths, including under --quiet, and no additional confirmation line may be printed alongside it

Seam return values that are consumed by other code (e.g. add_dependency returning dict | None for REDIRECT) must remain unchanged in type and meaning; outcome signals may be added only as parallel non-breaking channels
